content.json:
# Token Consumption from APIM logs and Billing

Per-user token consumption, chargeback and efficiency for model traffic routed through the API Management AI gateway.

parameters.name: UserKey
parameters.label: User
parameters.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | distinct UserKey | union (print UserKey = '*') | order by UserKey asc

parameters.name: AgentName
parameters.label: Agent
parameters.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | distinct AgentName | union (print AgentName = '*') | order by AgentName asc

parameters.name: ModelName
parameters.label: Model
parameters.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | distinct ModelName | union (print ModelName = '*') | order by ModelName asc

content.title: Headline metrics for the selected range
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), ActiveUsers = dcount(UserKey), InputTokens = sum(PromptTokens), OutputTokens = sum(CompletionTokens), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens), ListCostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), SuccessRatePct = round(100.0 * countif(toint(ResponseCode) < 400) / count(), 2), P95LatencyMs = round(percentile(toreal(TotalTime), 95), 0) | extend CostPerRequestUsd = round(ListCostUsd / todouble(Requests), 6), TokensPerRequest = round(todouble(TotalTokens) / todouble(Requests), 0), ListCostUsd = round(ListCostUsd, 4) | project Requests, ActiveUsers, TotalTokens, ListCostUsd, CostPerRequestUsd, TokensPerRequest, SuccessRatePct, P95LatencyMs | extend kv = pack_all() | mv-expand kind = array kv | project Metric = tostring(kv[0]), Value = tostring(kv[1])

content.json:
## Spend trends and anomalies

How consumption is moving over the selected range, and whether any day departs from the recent baseline.

content.title: Daily spend anomalies (30 day baseline, z-score)
content.query: let daily = HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | summarize CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), Requests = count(), Users = dcount(UserKey) by Day = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d); let stats = daily | summarize MeanUsd = avg(CostUsd), SdUsd = stdev(CostUsd) | extend k = 1; daily | extend k = 1 | join kind=inner stats on k | extend ZScore = iff(SdUsd > 0.0, round((CostUsd - MeanUsd) / SdUsd, 2), 0.0) | extend Status = case(SdUsd <= 0.0, 'insufficient history', ZScore >= 2.0, 'HIGH - investigate', ZScore <= -2.0, 'unusually low', 'normal') | project Day, CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 4), Requests, Users, BaselineUsd = round(MeanUsd, 4), ZScore, Status | order by Day desc

content.title: List cost over time by model
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), ModelName | order by TimeGenerated asc

content.title: Tokens over time by agent
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens) by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), AgentName | order by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
## Chargeback and allocation

Cost allocated to the pseudonymous user identity supplied by the Foundry platform. `Unallocated %` in the coverage panel is the FinOps KPI to drive toward zero.

content.title: Consumption and cost per user
content.query: let total = toscalar(HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize sum(EstimatedCostUsd)); HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), InputTokens = sum(PromptTokens), OutputTokens = sum(CompletionTokens), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens), CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), Agents = dcount(AgentName), Models = dcount(ModelName), Failures = countif(toint(ResponseCode) >= 400) by UserKey | extend CostPerRequestUsd = round(CostUsd / todouble(Requests), 6), TokensPerRequest = round(todouble(TotalTokens) / todouble(Requests), 0), CostSharePct = iff(total > 0.0, round(100.0 * CostUsd / total, 2), 0.0), CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 6) | order by CostUsd desc

content.title: Spend concentration - are a few users driving the bill?
content.query: let total = toscalar(HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize sum(EstimatedCostUsd)); HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | summarize CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), Requests = count() by UserKey | order by CostUsd desc | extend Rank = row_number() | extend CumulativeUsd = row_cumsum(CostUsd) | extend SharePct = iff(total > 0.0, round(100.0 * CostUsd / total, 2), 0.0), CumulativeSharePct = iff(total > 0.0, round(100.0 * CumulativeUsd / total, 2), 0.0) | project Rank, UserKey, Requests, CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 6), SharePct, CumulativeSharePct | take 20

content.title: Consumption and cost per agent
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), Users = dcount(UserKey), InputTokens = sum(PromptTokens), OutputTokens = sum(CompletionTokens), CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), MedianLatencyMs = round(percentile(toreal(TotalTime), 50), 0), P95LatencyMs = round(percentile(toreal(TotalTime), 95), 0) by AgentName | extend CostPerRequestUsd = round(CostUsd / todouble(Requests), 6), CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 6) | order by CostUsd desc

content.json:
## Unit economics and benchmarking

Cost per request and cost per 1K tokens let you compare agents and models on equal terms, and spot an expensive model being used for cheap work.

content.title: Unit cost by agent and model
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), InputTokens = sum(PromptTokens), OutputTokens = sum(CompletionTokens), TotalTokens = sum(TotalTokens), CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd) by AgentName, ModelName | extend CostPerRequestUsd = round(CostUsd / todouble(Requests), 6), CostPer1KTokensUsd = iff(TotalTokens > 0, round(1000.0 * CostUsd / todouble(TotalTokens), 6), 0.0), TokensPerRequest = round(todouble(TotalTokens) / todouble(Requests), 0), OutputToInputRatio = iff(InputTokens > 0, round(todouble(OutputTokens) / todouble(InputTokens), 2), 0.0), CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 6) | order by CostPer1KTokensUsd desc

content.title: Model mix and cost share
content.query: let total = toscalar(HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize sum(EstimatedCostUsd)); HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), Users = dcount(UserKey), InputTokens = sum(PromptTokens), OutputTokens = sum(CompletionTokens), CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), PricedRequests = countif(PriceKnown) by ModelName, DeploymentName | extend CostSharePct = iff(total > 0.0, round(100.0 * CostUsd / total, 2), 0.0), RequestSharePct = 0.0, PricingCoverage = strcat(PricedRequests, ' / ', Requests), CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 6) | project-away PricedRequests, RequestSharePct | order by CostUsd desc

content.title: Rate provenance and effective dates - how much of this bill is based on real billed rates
content.query: let total = toscalar(HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize sum(EstimatedCostUsd)); HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), CostUsd = sum(EstimatedCostUsd), RateEffectiveFrom = min(RateValidFrom) by ModelName, RateSource | extend CostSharePct = iff(total > 0.0, round(100.0 * CostUsd / total, 2), 0.0), CostUsd = round(CostUsd, 6) | extend Confidence = case(RateSource == 'billed', 'authoritative - rate observed in Cost Management', RateSource == 'mixed', 'partly authoritative - one direction still retail', RateSource == 'retail', 'estimate - public price list', 'not priced') | project ModelName, RateSource, Confidence, RateEffectiveFrom, Requests, CostUsd, CostSharePct | order by CostUsd desc

content.json:
## Efficiency and optimization

Prompt caching and reasoning tokens are the two largest controllable levers. Cached input is billed at a large discount, so a low cache hit rate on a repetitive workload is money left on the table. Reasoning tokens are billed as output but never shown to the user.

These panels read the gateway **token metrics**, not the gateway log, because the log carries no cached-token column. Rows recorded before the model dimension was added show an empty model and are not priced.

content.title: Prompt cache efficiency and savings
content.query: HostedAgentTokenCategories | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | summarize PromptTokens = sum(PromptTokens), CachedTokens = sum(CachedPromptTokens), BillableInputTokens = sum(BillableInputTokens), CacheAdjustedCostUsd = sum(CacheAdjustedCostUsd), CacheSavingsUsd = sum(CacheSavingsUsd) by AgentName, ModelName | extend CacheHitRatePct = iff(PromptTokens > 0, round(100.0 * todouble(CachedTokens) / todouble(PromptTokens), 2), 0.0), CacheAdjustedCostUsd = round(CacheAdjustedCostUsd, 6), CacheSavingsUsd = round(CacheSavingsUsd, 6) | order by CacheAdjustedCostUsd desc

content.title: Reasoning token overhead (billed as output, never displayed)
content.query: HostedAgentTokenCategories | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | summarize CompletionTokens = sum(CompletionTokens), ReasoningTokens = sum(ReasoningTokens), PromptTokens = sum(PromptTokens) by AgentName, ModelName | extend ReasoningSharePct = iff(CompletionTokens > 0, round(100.0 * todouble(ReasoningTokens) / todouble(CompletionTokens), 2), 0.0), VisibleOutputTokens = CompletionTokens - ReasoningTokens | order by ReasoningTokens desc

content.title: Token categories per user
content.query: HostedAgentTokenCategories | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | summarize PromptTokens = sum(PromptTokens), CachedPromptTokens = sum(CachedPromptTokens), CompletionTokens = sum(CompletionTokens), ReasoningTokens = sum(ReasoningTokens), CacheAdjustedCostUsd = round(sum(CacheAdjustedCostUsd), 6) by UserKey, AgentName | order by CacheAdjustedCostUsd desc

content.json:
## Reliability and performance

Failed and throttled calls still consume engineering time and can still consume tokens. A rising 429 count means the workload is hitting a token or rate limit and needs quota or load balancing.

content.title: Success, throttling and latency by agent
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | summarize Requests = count(), Succeeded = countif(toint(ResponseCode) < 400), Throttled429 = countif(toint(ResponseCode) == 429), ClientErrors4xx = countif(toint(ResponseCode) >= 400 and toint(ResponseCode) < 500 and toint(ResponseCode) != 429), ServerErrors5xx = countif(toint(ResponseCode) >= 500), P50LatencyMs = round(percentile(toreal(TotalTime), 50), 0), P95LatencyMs = round(percentile(toreal(TotalTime), 95), 0), P99LatencyMs = round(percentile(toreal(TotalTime), 99), 0), MedianBackendMs = round(percentile(toreal(BackendTime), 50), 0) by AgentName | extend SuccessRatePct = round(100.0 * todouble(Succeeded) / todouble(Requests), 2) | order by Requests desc

content.title: Response codes over time
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | summarize Requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), ResponseCode = tostring(ResponseCode) | order by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
## Adoption

Active users and requests per user show whether spend is growing because more people use the agents, or because the same people are using them more heavily.

content.title: Active users and requests over time
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where UserKey != 'unattributed' | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | summarize ActiveUsers = dcount(UserKey), Requests = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}) | extend RequestsPerUser = iff(ActiveUsers > 0, round(todouble(Requests) / todouble(ActiveUsers), 1), 0.0) | order by TimeGenerated asc

content.json:
## Data quality, coverage and audit

Trust the numbers above only as far as these panels allow. Unallocated cost cannot be charged back, and unpriced requests are counted as zero dollars.

content.title: Coverage and trust indicators
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | summarize Requests = count(), Unattributed = countif(UserKey == 'unattributed'), UnknownAgent = countif(AgentName == 'unknown'), UnpricedRequests = countif(PriceKnown == false), ZeroTokenRequests = countif(TotalTokens == 0), StreamedRequests = countif(IsStreamCompletion == true), FailedRequests = countif(toint(ResponseCode) >= 400) | extend UnallocatedCostPct = round(100.0 * todouble(Unattributed) / todouble(Requests), 2), UnpricedPct = round(100.0 * todouble(UnpricedRequests) / todouble(Requests), 2), MissingTokenDataPct = round(100.0 * todouble(ZeroTokenRequests) / todouble(Requests), 2)

content.title: Request audit trail (no prompt or completion content)
content.query: HostedAgentModelUsage | where TimeGenerated {TimeRange} | where '*' in ({UserKey}) or UserKey in ({UserKey}) | where '*' in ({AgentName}) or AgentName in ({AgentName}) | where '*' in ({ModelName}) or ModelName in ({ModelName}) | project TimeGenerated, UserKey, AgentName, ModelName, DeploymentName, Region, PromptTokens, CompletionTokens, TotalTokens, EstimatedCostUsd = round(EstimatedCostUsd, 6), ResponseCode, TotalTimeMs = TotalTime, BackendTimeMs = BackendTime, IsStreamCompletion, CorrelationId, RequestId | order by TimeGenerated desc | take 200

content.json:
## About this report

Where every number comes from, and what it does and does not mean.

| Source | What it provides | Cached tokens? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog` + `ApiManagementGatewayLogs` | Per-request tokens, model, latency, status. Joined on `CorrelationId`. | **No** - the table has only prompt, completion and total token columns |
| Gateway token metrics (`AppMetrics`) | Cached and reasoning token categories | Yes |
| **Cost Management** (`Microsoft.Consumption/usageDetails`) | **The rates.** Billed unit price per meter per day, which is what Azure actually charged. Read by `scripts\sync-model-prices.ps1` and embedded as an effective-dated table, so it is a point-in-time copy rather than a live feed. | No cached meter has billed yet |

Quantities are never taken from billing: token counts always come from the gateway, and billing supplies only the price. Billing does not carry a user dimension, so it cannot attribute cost on its own.

Model responses do return `usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens`, but API Management does not persist that breakdown to the log table. It is only captured by the `llm-emit-token-metric` policy, so any cached figure in this report comes from metrics rather than logs.

**Rates are effective-dated and tagged by provenance.** `billed` means the rate was observed in this subscription's own Cost Management records, so it is what Azure actually charged. `mixed` means one token direction is billed and the other is still retail. `retail` means public price list, which has been observed at **twice** the billed rate for the GPT-5 family. Check the rate provenance panel before treating any figure as chargeable.

**Two cost figures are shown deliberately.** *List cost* applies the effective rate to every input token and is an upper bound. *Cache-adjusted cost* prices cached input at its discounted rate. Neither is an invoice.

No prompts or completions are recorded. Requests that predate attribution appear as `unattributed` rather than being dropped, because missing token data is unavailable, not zero.

## Data as of

Different parts of this report are current to different points in time. Read this panel before quoting any figure.

| What | Freshness |
| --- | --- |
| Token counts, user attribution, latency, status | Near real time. Log Analytics ingestion is typically a few minutes behind the request. |
| Cached and reasoning token categories | Near real time, from gateway metrics, aggregated per minute. |
| **Rates** | **Not live.** Each rate carries an effective date and applies from that date onward. Billed rates are observed in Cost Management, which lags usage by roughly a day for model meters. |

Rates are refreshed by running `scripts\sync-model-prices.ps1`. Until that is re-run, newly changed prices are not reflected.

content.title: Freshness of every source, including the rates
content.query: let llm = ApiManagementGatewayLlmLog | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | summarize Latest = max(TimeGenerated), Items = count() | extend Source = '1. Token counts (gateway LLM log)', Kind = 'telemetry'; let gwl = ApiManagementGatewayLogs | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where ApiId == 'hosted-agents-models' | summarize Latest = max(TimeGenerated), Items = count() | extend Source = '2. User attribution (gateway request log)', Kind = 'telemetry'; let met = AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d) | where Name == 'Total Tokens' | summarize Latest = max(TimeGenerated), Items = count() | extend Source = '3. Cached and reasoning tokens (gateway metrics)', Kind = 'telemetry'; let rate = HostedAgentModelUsage | where isnotnull(RateValidFrom) | summarize Latest = max(RateValidFrom), Items = dcount(ModelName) | extend Source = '4. Model rates (Cost Management, via sync script)', Kind = 'rate'; union llm, gwl, met, rate | extend AgeMinutes = round(todouble(datetime_diff('minute', now(), Latest)), 0) | extend AgeDays = round(AgeMinutes / 1440.0, 1) | extend Freshness = case(Kind == 'rate' and AgeMinutes <= 10080.0, 'current - rates change rarely', Kind == 'rate', 'review - rerun sync-model-prices.ps1', AgeMinutes <= 15.0, 'current', AgeMinutes <= 120.0, 'slightly behind', 'no recent traffic, or ingestion delayed') | project Source, DataAsOfUtc = Latest, AgeDays, Items, Freshness | order by Source asc
